findings.what: The retry-attempt ordinal string uses ICU `plural` with hand-picked `=2`/`=3` exact matches instead of `selectordinal`, so it prints the wrong suffix once attempts reach 21 ("21th run" instead of "21st run", and again at 22/23/31/32/33...).
findings.evidence: en.json: `"attempt": "{n, plural, one {#st run} =2 {2nd run} =3 {3rd run} other {#th run}}"`. English CLDR `plural` category `one` matches only n=1, so n=21 falls to `other` -> "21th run". Rendered from `client-work-attention.tsx:150` (`t("attempt", { n: row.attempts })`), fed by `_work_run_attempts.attempts` which is not bounded, so a Work with 21+ runs would show the wrong ordinal. Cosmetic only — no AC references this string, and realistic attempt counts are small.
findings.fix: Use ICU `selectordinal` instead of `plural`, e.g. `"attempt": "{n, selectordinal, one {#st run} two {#nd run} few {#rd run} other {#th run}}"`, which computes the correct English ordinal category for every n.
